in_sanskrit.name: कविन्दी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess of poetry, wisdom, and knowledge

in_marathi.name: Kavindi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavindi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'kavi' (poet) and 'indriya' (senses). Kavindi signifies one who has a poetic or artistic intelligence.

in_bengali.name: Kavindi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Poetic Intelligence
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kavindi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'kavi' (poet) and 'indriya' (senses). Kavindi signifies one who has a poetic or artistic intelligence.
